{{Quote|Attacked by surprise en route to the research facility's lower levels. Teraud is no where to be seen, but his loyalists ambushed my Stormtrooper escort. We were divided in the battle and I've been badly wounded, captured, and thrown into a cell. I do not expect help to arrive in time.|Janna bel Arde's last report|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Janna bel Arde''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Janna bel Arde was dispatched by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ardus Kaine]] to inspect [[The Warren (Dantooine)|the Warren]], a secret Imperial research facility located on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], because its commanding officer, [[Bors Teraud]], was suspected of treachery. Teraud was indeed a traitor and his loyalists ambushed the Inquisitor and her [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] escort during the inspection. Janna bel Arde was badly wounded, captured and imprisoned, eventually dying of her injuries in her cell.<ref name="SWG" />
